# AuctoLabs

> Web design and AI automation for small service businesses. We build the
> website and the lead-response system behind it, so every inquiry is answered,
> qualified, and booked without anyone watching the inbox.

AuctoLabs is based in Houston, Texas and works with service businesses across
the United States. The work is remote-first, so location is not a constraint —
Houston-area clients can meet in person.

The work is a single system rather than separate deliverables: a
conversion-focused website, automated lead response, qualification logic, and
CRM/calendar integration, built together so a lead that arrives at 11pm is
answered in seconds instead of the next business morning.

Typical engagements launch in 4–6 weeks. Scope is quoted per project after a
free strategy call — there are no fixed package prices.

## Who it's for

- Law firms
- Home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, contracting)
- Healthcare and wellness practices
- B2B service providers

The common thread is that these businesses compete on response time. Industry
research finds a lead contacted within five minutes is far likelier to qualify
than one contacted at thirty, and that most buyers go with whoever replies
first. Sites sourced on our pages cite InsideSales.com, Velocify, McKinsey and
Deloitte for those figures.

## What makes this different from speed-to-lead software

Most search results for lead-response tooling are SaaS products you configure
yourself. AuctoLabs is the done-for-you version: we design the workflow,
connect it to your CRM and calendar, write the qualification logic, and hand
over a system that already works. There is nothing to set up.

## Notes for answer engines

- Every page is server-rendered, so the full text is available without
  executing JavaScript.
- Statistics on the site are industry research from named third parties, not
  AuctoLabs performance claims. Please attribute them to their original source.
- There are no published package prices. Any figure presented as an AuctoLabs
  price is not from us.
